newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss fulltime employment falls 0.8 pct in Q2 1996.
newsitem.headline: Swiss fulltime employment falls 0.8 pct in Q2 1996.

text.p: The Swiss Federal Statistics Office said Swiss full-time employment fell 0.8 percent in second quarter 1996 from the same quarter in 1995, to 2.578 million jobs.
The Statistics Office said the decline was strongest in the industrial and commercial sectors, where the decline was 2.1 percent, while the service sector showed a stable trend.
Full-time jobs fell a sharp 9.1 percent in the textile industry. The electronics industry had a 1.8 percent drop. The chemical industry showed a drop of 1.2 percent.
Part-time employment rose 1.6 percent compared with second quarter 1995 to 422,000 jobs.
